title: 第9章 升级第10章 灭魔先锋
content_zh:
“击杀一级骷髅小兵，经验+5，功勋+1。”
“0阶灵魂碎片+1。”
日志信息中显示了击杀记录。
方南山则把目光投向地上的两件掉落物品，一粒黄豆般小的白色晶体，一块半根手指般短小的小骨头。
“魔晶，硬化骨，一共20元。”
他弯腰拾起，存放在背包空格中，各占了一格，但同类物品在格子里可以叠加。
这是每个骷髅怪都会掉落的基本材料。
硬化骸骨也是骷髅怪的实力象征，一级只掉一块，二级会有两块，等级越高硬化骨越多，一阶的骷髅还会进化成玉骨或魔骨，拥有魔纹，可以施展技能。
没时间多考虑，感应范围内一只游荡的骷髅已经举着骨剑一步一步赶过来。
方南山看着它走来，甚至有点嫌弃它移动速度太慢了，提着剑主动迎上去。
骷髅只有一个动作，就是砍，很容易避开，动作显得缓慢笨拙，所以方南山并没有费什么劲，又是四剑斩杀，本身毫发不损，十分轻松。
“简单，太简单！我要一挑二。”
连杀三个骷髅怪之后，方南山觉得还可以再提升一下强度，先前的谨慎有点过于保守了，他毕竟算是氪金小佬。
于是他信心满满的走向侧面扎堆的那几个骷髅，一下子引来四个骷髅追杀。
“它们速度都不如我，可以边打边退，只要不被四个包围住，我能把它们一一斩杀。”
他现在敏捷很高，远胜骷髅，无论灵活还是移动都碾压对手，缺乏的只是对敌的经验。
战术很成功，四个骷髅被他轻松的走位卡位置，没机会同时对他出手，两三分钟后就一一倒下。
收起材料，他也没有浪费时间，继续战斗。
如果算上走位及赶路，他差不多三十秒就能击杀一只骷髅。
十分钟之后，据点护罩四周五十米范围内的所有骷髅，都被他清理了。

“击杀一级骷髅小兵，经验+5，功勋+1。”
“等级经验已足够，是否提升个人等级？”
第二十个骷髅散架之后，方南山的等级经验正好满100，可以升级了。
提升个人等级！
他没有犹豫，马上升级，个人等级一下子从0级，变成了1级，一道光柱把他笼罩，三秒后才消失。
“恭喜修士等级提升到0阶一级，在修行道路上踏出坚实的一步，请再接再厉，勇攀高峰。”
“等级提升，自由属性点+4。”
没什么说的，这种情况方南山熟悉，以前网游没少玩。虽然这里很真实，但是显然也是由某些大神通强者修改了法则，使得一切都接近于游戏规则的玩法，这也更加方便登陆仙界的生物踏上修行变强之路。
毕竟他们在这里的身体，都是特殊塑造而成的，数据化的产物，自然也应该以数据化的提升为途径。
content_en:
"Kill the first-level skeleton soldier, experience +5, merit +1."
"Level 0 soul fragment +1."
Kill records are displayed in the log information.
Fang Nanshan turned his attention to the two fallen objects on the ground, a white crystal as small as a soybean, and a small bone as short as half a finger.
"Magic crystal, hardened bone, total 20 yuan."
He bent down to pick them up and stored them in the empty spaces of his backpack. Each item occupied one slot, but similar items could be stacked in the slots.
This is the basic material that every skeleton monster will drop.
Hardened bones are also a symbol of the strength of the skeleton monster. Only one piece will be dropped at the first level, and two pieces will be dropped at the second level. The higher the level, the more hardened bones there will be. The first-level skeletons will also evolve into jade bones or demon bones, which have magic patterns and can use skills.
There was no time to think about it. A wandering skeleton within the sensing range was already approaching step by step with a bone sword raised.
Fang Nanshan watched it coming, even a little dissatisfied that it moved too slowly, and took the initiative to meet it with his sword in hand.
The skeleton only has one movement, which is to cut. It is easy to avoid, and the movements are slow and clumsy, so Fang Nanshan did not put any effort into it and killed it with four swords. It was unscathed and very easy.
"Simple, too simple! I want to challenge two."
After killing three skeleton monsters in a row, Fang Nanshan felt that he could increase his strength a little more. His previous caution was a bit too conservative. After all, he was considered a money-making guy.
So he confidently walked towards the skeletons clustered on the side, and suddenly attracted four skeletons to chase him.
"They are not as fast as me. They can fight and retreat at the same time. As long as they are not surrounded by four, I can kill them one by one."
He is now very agile, far better than skeletons. He can crush his opponents regardless of flexibility or movement. What he lacks is just experience in fighting the enemy.
The tactic was very successful. The four skeletons were blocked by his easy movement and had no chance to attack him at the same time. They fell one by one after two or three minutes.
Putting away the materials, he wasted no time and continued fighting.
If you include positioning and rushing, he can kill a skeleton in about thirty seconds.
Ten minutes later, he had cleared away all the skeletons within fifty meters of the stronghold shield.
"Kill the first-level skeleton soldier, experience +5, merit +1."
"I have enough level experience. Do you want to increase your personal level?"
After the twentieth skeleton fell apart, Fang Nanshan's level experience reached 100 and he was ready to upgrade.
Improve your personal level!
He did not hesitate and immediately upgraded. His personal level suddenly changed from level 0 to level 1. A beam of light enveloped him and disappeared after three seconds.
"Congratulations to the monk for your promotion to level 0 and level 1. You have taken a solid step on the path of spiritual practice. Please continue your efforts and bravely climb to the top."
"Level up, free attribute points +4."
There is nothing to say. Fang Nanshan is familiar with this situation. He has played online games a lot in the past. Although this is very real, it is obvious that some powerful people with great supernatural powers have modified the rules, making everything close to the rules of the game. This also makes it easier for creatures who have landed in the fairy world to embark on the road to practice and become stronger.
After all, their bodies here are specially shaped, and digital products should naturally be improved through digitalization.
